question:
**Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence.**

Drunkeness, riot and brawling were the order, there, every night.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Drunkenness."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Drunkenness"** is spelled incorrectly in the given sentence.
 
• The correct spelling is **"Drunkenness"** with two **"n"s.**
 
• **"Drunkenness" **means the state of being drunk; intoxication. (मदोन्‍मत्तता)
 
 
• **Example**: *They want the city to rid the streets of public **drunkenness**__ and the resulting crime.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

**Correct sentence**: *__**Drunkenness**__, riot and brawling were the order, there, every night.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Riot," "Order," and "Brawling"** are spelled correctly in the sentence.
 
• **"Riot"** refers to a violent disturbance of the peace. (दंगा, बलवा, हंगामा (लोगों द्वारा किसी सार्वजनिक स्‍थान पर, प्रायः विरोधस्‍वरूप))
 
• **"Order"** refers to a state of peace and stability. (व्‍यवस्थित क्रम, सिलसिला)
 
• **"Brawling"** refers to fighting or quarreling. (झड़प होना)
